name: Travel tack porter
design: Tall slender adult male Yautja, silvery-grey dark-spotted skin, long strong rear skull and four long separately readable mandibular arms, heavy black scalp tendrils bound with one ring low behind. Faded russet wrap tunic under a dark leather cross harness, long split olive waist panels, simple wristbands. Compact cylindrical tack roll strapped across upper back; holds one neat coil of leather straps in left hand, right arm relaxed.
